note: The alates are dealate individuals (5 specimens, antennae broken off), which the author assigns to the same species as the soldiers on the grounds that they come from the same locality and the same collecting series (Remarks in the original). Adapted from the original description by Krishna & Emerson 1962.

sections.label: Diagnostic characters
sections.text:
Compared with G. jurioni the dealate adult of this species has a wider head, larger eyes of a different shape, a longer pronotum with narrower anterolateral corners and a slightly concave posterior margin; compared with G. ignotus the head is slightly narrower, the eye shape different, the ocelli less round, and the pronotum narrower with straighter sides; compared with G. reticulatus the head is wider, the eyes larger and of a different shape, the ocelli very close to but not touching the eyes, and the pronotum longer with angular posterolateral margins. G. kawandae, G. insulanus, G. parki and G. longuisculus are larger in all parts. Compared with G. jurioni the soldier has a narrower posterior part of the head, the outer margin of the mandible base not wavy, a shallower concavity of the anterior margin of the pronotum and an indistinct posterior concavity; compared with G. ignotus all measurements are slightly smaller, the tubercle at the mandible base less prominent, the sides of the anterior half of the postmentum parallel, and the anterolateral corners of the pronotum narrower.

The type locality is Camp Putnam on the Eru River, Congo (1°24′ N, 28°36′ E); the soldier holotype and paratypes and the nymphs were collected by A. E. Emerson on 17 May 1948 (month 5) from a living hardwood tree on the river bank; the dealate adults (morphotype and paramorphotype) were collected on the same day, at the same place and from the same host.

sections.label: Alate
sections.text:
Dealate individuals. Head dark brown; pronotum almost the same colour as the head; antennae and femora light brown; tibiae pale yellow; nota brown, paler than the head and pronotum; sternites paler than the tergites. Head with a few sparse erect setae; margins and disc of the pronotum with both long and short setae. Head semicircular behind the eyes. Eyes shaped as figured. Ocelli oval, touching the eyes. Antennae broken off; segment 2 equal to segment 3, segment 4 shorter than segments 2 and 3. Pronotum slightly narrower than the head, anterior margin concave, anterolateral corners narrow, posterior margin slightly concave.

Measurements of 5 dealate adults (range / mean): head length (to the tip of the labrum) 0.98—1.05 mm / 1.01 mm; head length (to the base of the mandibles) 0.79—0.81 mm / 0.79 mm; head width 0.83—0.86 mm / 0.84 mm; diameter of the eye 0.25—0.29 mm / 0.27 mm; distance from the lower margin of the eye 0.09—0.13 mm / 0.12 mm; length of the ocellus 0.05—0.07 mm / 0.06 mm; pronotum median length 0.45—0.49 mm / 0.47 mm; pronotum width 0.68—0.75 mm / 0.71 mm; length of the hind tibia 0.66—0.70 mm / 0.69 mm.

sections.label: Soldier
sections.text:
Head yellow with a light brown tinge, the frontal region brown; pronotum pale yellow, paler than the head; mandibles reddish brown; antennae, legs and nota pale yellow. Head with a few sparse erect setae; margins and disc of the pronotum with both long and short setae. Head small, sides parallel; middle of the frons very slightly concave; anterodorsal projection indistinct; frontal face forming a slope of about 40—45° in lateral view. Labrum with sides converging anteriorly and a blunt anterior margin. Mandibles short, the outer margin of the base wavy; left mandible with 3 marginal teeth, the posterior margin of the second and the anterior margin of the third forming a concave cutting edge; right mandible with 2 marginal teeth, the tip of the first marginal tooth lying 0.24 mm from the tip of the apical tooth. Postmentum shaped as figured, variable, the two sides sometimes slightly angular in the anterior region. Antennae 10—11-segmented; in the 10-segmented antenna segments 3 and 4 subequal in length, in the 11-segmented one segment 3 shorter than segment 4. Pronotum slightly narrower than the head, anterior margin broadly concave with a small median notch, anterolateral corners narrow, sides converging posteriorly, posterior margin slightly concave. Femora not swollen.

Soldier measurements (holotype; range / mean of 5 specimens): head length (to the base of the mandibles) 1.31 mm / 1.26—1.37 mm / 1.33 mm; head width 0.86 mm / 0.86—0.90 mm / 0.88 mm; head height 0.83 mm / 0.82—0.83 mm / 0.83 mm; length of the left mandible 0.66 mm / 0.64—0.68 mm / 0.67 mm; postmentum maximum width 0.30 mm / 0.30—0.34 mm / 0.32 mm; postmentum minimum width 0.15 mm / 0.13—0.15 mm / 0.15 mm; postmentum length 0.90 mm / 0.83—0.94 mm / 0.89 mm; pronotum median length 0.40 mm / 0.39—0.43 mm / 0.41 mm; pronotum maximum length 0.53 mm / 0.45—0.53 mm / 0.51 mm; pronotum width 0.83 mm / 0.79—0.83 mm / 0.82 mm; length of the hind tibia 0.54 mm / 0.54—0.60 mm / 0.58 mm.
